name: desktop-update
description: A line above the prompt when a newer Claude Desktop (Windows, MSIX) is on Anthropic's update feed, with a one-click install that closes Desktop, updates the package and starts it again, and a switch that turns Desktop's own auto-update off or on (policy value, UAC prompt).

relaunch.title: Start Desktop after the update
relaunch.description: cmd.exe command line run after the install, to start Claude Desktop again. Join several commands with &. Empty: the Start menu entry of the Claude package.
